pages.text: The Coker heats 250 mB of Bitumen for 60 ticks at 420°C, consuming 25 HU per tick. It produces 1 Petroleum Coke, 50 mB Refinery Gas, and 50 mB Heavy Oil. Supply heat with a Thermal Conduit. A Speed Upgrade shortens processing time and increases heat draw. This Horizon alpha supports the Bitumen recipe, two fluid outputs, one item output, and fixed-capacity tanks; the source mod’s reflux, automatic fluid routing, and other Coker recipes are not implemented yet.
